title: Add network mDNS coordinator discovery
summary: Implement D2 from the network worker hardening plan by bundling zeroconf and exposing backend-owned worker coordinator discovery.
reason: Workers should not depend on manually typed coordinator IP/host values when the coordinator can advertise itself on the LAN.
behavior_before: Coordinator mDNS advertisement was optional and missing zeroconf only logged a warning; workers had no Local API/WebView discovery command and had to type the coordinator URL manually.
behavior_after: The bundled dependency set includes zeroconf, coordinators advertise through the existing mDNS code path, and workers can scan for mDNS coordinators through a backend-owned discovery route surfaced in the Network WebView.
